breakdown.description: A horizontal traction on the vertical edge x = 0 is reinterpreted as tangential shear, even though it is normal to that edge
breakdown.reason: The user's prompt contained a physically incorrect statement: interpreting a horizontal traction on a vertical edge (a normal force) as a tangential shear force. The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect interpretation. The agent, however, failed to correct this. It explicitly incorporated the user's error, stating to "impose a shear traction of magnitude 4000 Pa acting in the positive x-direction (to the right), tangent to the edge." This repeats the user's flawed instruction instead of fixing it.
